page_title: MAL 1-0 PAL | Mallorca v Las Palmas 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+3' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+2' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Abdon Prats (Mallorca) heads on.
90+1' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner which is cleared.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
85' The referee is firm and issues Jose Copete (Mallorca) a deserved yellow card.
84' Javier Aguirre has decided to substitute Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud and he is replaced by Nacho Vidal (Mallorca).
83' A substitution has been made. Vedat Muriqi is replaced by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca).
81' Mika Marmol picks out Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) with a lofted pass into the centre of the box, but his header rises just over the crossbar.
80' This is a yellow card! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear. Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) will miss the next game.
78' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) replacing Julian Araujo.
78' Here comes a substitution. Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is brought on as a substitute for Enzo Loiodice.
78' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card. Martin Valjent (Mallorca) will miss the next game.
76' The attendance is 16050.
75' Marvin (Las Palmas) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
73' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Alvaro Valles is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergi Darder (Mallorca) will replace Daniel Rodriguez.
71' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alvaro Valles, who smothers the ball.
70' The referee gives a yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca).
68' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Las Palmas was in an offside position.
66' The corner from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is cleared away by the defence.

66' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee blows his whistle, Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
63' Antonio Sanchez goes off the pitch and Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on.
63' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Sory Kaba is replaced by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
63' Substitution. Javier Munoz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
62' Substitution. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) in, Cyle Larin out.
62' Las Palmas take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

62' Predrag Rajkovic makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner. The ball goes out for a corner. Las Palmas can continue in their attacking effort.
58' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card. Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
57' Kirian Rodriguez plays a pass into the path of Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
55' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
55' Samu Costa (Mallorca) brings an opponent down and Juan Martinez Munuera interrupts the game. Las Palmas have a free kick from a promising distance.
52' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) brought his opponent down.
51' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
48' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
46' Half-time substitution. Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decided to make a change. Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) is replaced by Alberto Moleiro.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Juan Martinez Munuera has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Jose Copete (Mallorca) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.

40' So close! Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
39' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez Munuera signals a set piece. Las Palmas are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
39' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' 4:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
34' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
32' No offside! Referee Juan Martinez Munuera points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Mallorca players celebrate.
31' Wait! Referee Juan Martinez Munuera has indicated he is going to review the Mallorca goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
29' 1 - 0 Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) scores a glorious goal after latching onto a cross and smashing the ball inside the left post with a first-time volley!
28' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
28' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. A free kick to Mallorca.
26' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) sprays a pass out to Enzo Loiodice, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
24' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but Alvaro Valles punches the ball away.
23' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) plays a long ball to Cyle Larin, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
21' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
18' Samu Costa (Mallorca) attempts to find Cyle Larin, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
16' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
14' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
13' Mallorca couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
11' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
8' The ball is cleared after Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
1' Samu Costa (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alvaro Valles intercepts the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Juan Martinez Munuera was nominated as the referee for this game.
